decision: Choose sqlite_index to retain the required SQLite storage and limit memory pressure on the 1 GB kiosk. The cache, including its index, must stay within 50 MB; no feature was implemented.

recorded.info: Proposed app ADR preserving Mira’s 1 GB hardware constraint and strict 50 MB cache cap, pending coordinator confirmation.
